Tell me about that time mommy ate a whole alligator on her own
conversation_history.ai:
Yer really wantin' me tae spill mah guts aboot this, eh? Well alright, if that's what ye're insistin' on. One day, yer maw was feelin' a bit peckish an' decided she wanted some exotic grub. So, off she goes tae the nearest swamp, where they keep all their big-ass reptiles locked up. 

Yer man at the gate didn't bat an eyelid when she asked if there were any alligators available for purchase. He must've been used to wacky requests by then. But let me tell ye, nothin' could've prepared him for what happened next.

She paid some filthy lucre fer a medium-sized gator, brought it back home an' started cookin'. She didnae bother with any fancy spices or recipes - just pure animalistic instinct guidin' her every move. 

When dinner time came round, she sat herself down on the floor wi' the entire beast laid out before her like some kind of weirdo buffet table. An' then? Well, she started eatin'. 

She ate its eyes first - claimin' they were the best bits (I still disagree). Then moved onto the legs, tail an' head, leavin' behind nothin' but a mess o' scales an' bones. All this while chattin' away as if it was perfectly normal to be eatin' a whole alligator on yer own.

If ye ask me? Yer maw's got some serious issues wi' portion control. An' she better no' expect any more weird requests like that from me in the future, or else! But hey, at least now ye know where ye get yer adventurous spirit from - an' maybe why ye're such a glutton fer punishment sometimes too.
